```
SELECT table_name
FROM dba_tables
WHERE owner='AE'
AND table_name NOT IN (
    SELECT TABLE_NAME
    FROM dba_tab_privs
    WHERE owner='AE'
    AND GRANTEE='T1'
)
AND table_name NOT IN (
    SELECT TABLE_NAME
```
